text: Enterprise API Gateway specifies a maximum allowed API request payload size of 10 MB for standard REST endpoints. Streaming gRPC and WebSocket endpoints permit up to 50 MB payload buffer size.

source_title: SOC2 Type II Audit & Log Retention Policy
text: Security audit logs, system access logs, and administrative trace logs must be securely archived and retained for at least 7 years to satisfy SOC2 Type II compliance audit regulations.
GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure mandates that customer PII data must be permanently erased from all production and backup stores within 30 calendar days upon receipt of a valid deletion request.
Idle connection timeout MUST be set to 30 seconds for all PostgreSQL production pools to prevent connection starvation under peak loads.
Subscriptions cancelled within 14 days of purchase qualify for a 100% full refund. Cancellations past 14 days receive a pro-rated credit refund applied to the account balance.
Database metrics should be retrieved using the cluster status tool. Primary node CPU utilization thresholds above 80% require immediate auto-scaling alerts.
